title: catpart-inspect output, schema v0
description: Version-0 report emitted by `catpart-inspect <file>` (ticket #11). Fields describe the outer container structure documented in docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md: the 32-byte header (magic at bytes 0-8, big-endian dword at bytes 8-12) and the container-name strings. Evolution is additive within a schema version: consumers must ignore properties they do not know. The detected-version field (version-detection ticket #13) was added on that basis while the schema stayed v0; it is documented but not required so reports emitted before ticket #13 still validate.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only by a breaking output change; additive changes keep the version.

magic.description: ASCII decoding of header bytes 0-8 with trailing NUL bytes stripped: 'V5_CFV2' on well-formed files. Reported as observed, not verified: 6 corpus files are known to carry a different magic.

header_dword.description: Big-endian uint32 at header bytes 8-12. Always below file size in the Phase 1 corpus (size - dword has median 10280); semantics not yet proven, so the value is reported as-is.

detected_version.description: Release marker (V5RxxSPxxHFxx) detected from the embedded CNEXTINFOS string (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md, 'Per-file version marker'): 8 KB window first, 64 KB fallback, 'unknown' when no marker is present (map decision on ticket #4; 338/1818 corpus files).

container_names.description: Container-name strings found in the file: unique, in first-occurrence order, whole-name matches against the vocabulary documented in the Phase 1 evidence note (docs/evidence/2026-11-07-container-triage.md, container name table ~0x7e4-0xd00).
